## Each kit contains

- **About the company** — what they do, stage/funding, team, tech stack
- **Why I fit** — grounded in my profile
- **Apply channels** — direct apply link + what the form requires
- **People to connect** — names + LinkedIn URLs (+ public email where found)
- **Draft founder/recruiter email** and a **LinkedIn note (<300 chars)**
- **Draft answers** to any application-form questions

## Flagged, not kitted

Worth a manual look — I couldn't build grounded kits for these:

- **SuperDocs — Founding Full-Stack AI Engineer (remote India):** promising on paper, but 5+ unrelated products share the name "SuperDocs" and I couldn't confirm which company this listing belongs to. Won't fabricate research for outreach. → identify the company on the [LinkedIn post](https://www.linkedin.com/comm/jobs/view/4437213289) first.
- **LinkedIn alert listings with a mangled company name** — e.g. "Staff Software Engineer (up to 75 LPA)", "Founding engineer, Full-Stack AI (LLMs & Agentic AI)", "Forward Deployed Engineer". The email parser split the company off, so there's no name to research. Open each on LinkedIn to see who's hiring.
